title: Read-only ACE source views, grants and boundary rule
flag: none (the views are the read path)
status_text: Ready. 14 Section B views wait for RWB-ACE-001
goal: Recovery code reads ACE only through 30 SELECT-only views
why: One copy of source data. ACE cascades deletes on account, so there is no FK into public; links are business keys. Views rename ACE columns for the Workbench.
triggers: ArchUnit rule BND-6 on every PR

ace.note: id_no_masked + id_no_last4 only; clear ID stays in ACE
4 ACE plan tables in one view

writes.note: consent and quality per phone / email / address

reads.note: one dictionary row per view column

stores: flyway_schema_history_recovery; roles ace_view_owner (owns views) and recovery_svc (SELECT on views only); recovery-modules.yaml sourceViews
rules: BR1: recovery reads ACE only via the 30 SELECT-only views; it loads, copies and transforms nothing
BR3: recovery_svc holds no privilege in public; PUBLIC holds nothing; no write on a view
BR4: no constraint in recovery references public; links are varchar(255) business keys
BR9: a Section B view is created only after its ACE table exists (V0003 after RWB-ACE-001)
